title: The Atlas of Valparaíso
author: Jude Brightwater
blurb: Silas Eriksen, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
